text: Meaning 'anointed one', the same as the Hebrew 'Messiah'. It refers to the Savior God sent.
Life shared with God that does not end in death. It begins here and now.
Being cut off from God forever and ruined.
In the Bible, sin is turning away from God and living as my own master. The wages of sin are the price paid in return for it.
God's radiant and holy majesty. People were first made to reflect it.
Training body and mind in an effort to reach enlightenment or salvation.
The wooden frame on which Rome nailed criminals to die. Jesus died there in our place for our sins.
The one who rescues us from sin and death: Jesus.
A person who trusts in Jesus and can now call God Father. It is a status received as a gift, not earned by deeds.
A Hebrew word meaning 'truly, it is so'. It is said at the end of a prayer to agree with all one's heart.
Jesus coming back to life in his body three days after he died: the resurrection.
